name: 04046 · Kennebunkport, ME
findings: ZIP 04046 (Kennebunkport) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04046 (Kennebunkport) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
